open_issues: Dependency chains chosen this run: 6.6 <- 6.3a + 6.3b; 6.5 <- 4.5 + 6.3a + 6.6; 6.4 <- 4.5 + 6.3b + 6.6. Decision 16 only says 6.6 is 'after 6.3a'; 6.3b was added because it edits the privacy page's Service providers paragraph and the Data Safety crash-logs row. If the founder skips Sentry (6.3b), the assembler should drop that edge and repoint 6.4 to 6.3a. Suggested M6 order: 6.1a-c, 6.2a-b, 6.3a-b, 6.6, 6.5, 6.4.

Names chosen for 6.6 (decision 16 does not name them): docs/legal/privacy-approved.md and terms-approved.md hand-off files (or pasted under '### APPROVED PRIVACY POLICY' / '### APPROVED TERMS OF SERVICE' + 'Effective date:'), apps/web/src/content/legal.test.ts (source-text comparison against the mobile deletion-copy.ts, no cross-app import), apps/web/e2e/smoke/legal.spec.ts, apps/web/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx (only if 2.1a/3.8 left no footer), apps/mobile/src/features/legal/openLegalPage.ts, HANDOFF heading '## Legal entity'. The privacy contact email is deliberately public and therefore appears in legal.ts/HANDOFF/prompt_history.txt — the one intended exception to the no-real-email rule.

6.6 forbids the agent from writing or editing legal wording; it must stop if the approved text contradicts the product (decision 15's 30-day window, deactivate path, US-East hosting, Stripe). The founder must produce approved text (lawyer, generator, or both) before the agent prompt runs.

Names chosen for 6.5: cli.appVersionSource 'remote' in eas.json (required by current eas-cli for autoIncrement; G11 revisers may add it in 4.1a upfront), submit.production.android = { track: internal, releaseStatus: completed, changesNotSentForReview: false } with the Play key stored via 'eas credentials -p android' (Play Store submissions entry) instead of G1's superseded 'eas secret:create', gitignore patterns play-service-account.json / *service-account*.json, docs/PLAY_STORE_LISTING.md, HANDOFF heading 'Google Play', demo-church + password reviewer-account convention (shared with 6.4), android.allowBackup false. Exact Play Console menu labels and the current eas.json submit field set are unverified offline.

Play policy facts in 6.5 the founder should re-confirm at run time: first .aab must be uploaded through the Console UI; personal developer accounts created after Nov 2023 need a closed test (20 testers, 14 days) before production access — internal testing is not gated and the plan stops there (production release proposed as 6.8); the 'Free' choice is irreversible; android.package is immutable after first upload (Firebase, Play and app.config.ts must agree, including case if the founder confirmed com.Anacast.app).

Names chosen for 6.4: server env var APPLE_TEAM_ID (Vercel), route apps/web/app/.well-known/apple-app-site-association/route.ts (404 until the Team ID is set), constant IOS_BUNDLE_ID in apps/web/src/lib/mobile-app.ts (or whatever file G13's undrafted 5.7 creates for the Android assetlinks constants — should be one shared file), docs/APP_STORE_PRIVACY.md, HANDOFF heading 'iOS / TestFlight', TestFlight group 'Church leaders', ios.config.usesNonExemptEncryption false, expo-image-picker purpose strings (only if G12's 5.2b installed it).

6.4 assumes no Mac: EAS cloud builds; 'npx expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install --clean' on Linux is used only to grep the generated Info.plist (needs network) and is deleted afterwards. If prebuild cannot run in the agent's environment the grep check moves to the founder's machine via docs/MOBILE_BUILD.md.

Apple-review readings recorded in 6.4 that may want a second opinion: no In-App Purchase needed (churches buy on the web; the app never links to checkout — guideline 3.1.3(b)); Sign in with Apple not required (no third-party login, guideline 4.8); 6.3a's in-app Delete with the 30-day window satisfies guideline 5.1.1(v) if the copy states it. 6.4 stops at TestFlight; App Store review is in proposed 6.8.

Lock-screen 'Now Playing' metadata on iOS depends on the installed expo-audio API (4.2b already allows a 'pending expo-audio API' deviation); 6.4 keeps that allowance and forbids react-native-track-player.

Store assets (512x512 icon without alpha, 1024x500 feature graphic, iOS 1024x1024 opaque icon, screenshots) depend on brand colours still open in HANDOFF; 6.5/6.4 keep Expo's template icon and add a HANDOFF to-do rather than invent a brand.

Earlier-run issues retained in the file: 6.3a must be revised per decision 15 (Deactivate = archive/restore; Delete = archive now + 30-day grace) and its notes/prompt still describe immediate deletion; 6.1/6.2 splits and name choices; the 9997 migration paste has no founder step; 5.5/4.3/3.6 dependency ids may need repointing at assembly.
